items.title: EIP-8038：撤销 SSTORE 清除退款，防止有利可图的往返
items.note: （misilva73）提交并合并。在一笔交易内把槽改回原值（如 `x → 0 → x`）时，清除时给的 `STORAGE_CLEAR_REFUND` 在恢复时没有撤回，净状态无变化却能得到 9380 gas 的净退款。
items.title_en: EIP-8038: reverse the SSTORE clear refund to prevent net-profitable round trips
items.note_en: (misilva73), submitted and merged. When a slot is returned to its original value within one transaction (for example `x → 0 → x`), the `STORAGE_CLEAR_REFUND` granted on the clear was never reversed on restore, leaving a net refund of 9,380 gas despite no net state change.

items.title: EIP-7778：无退款的区块 gas 计算，增加退款去向规则
items.title_en: EIP-7778: block gas accounting without refunds, with a rule for where refunds go

items.note: 00:29（mikeneuder）。原生 zkEVM 通常被描述为执行扩容，验证者只需下载并验证整个区块的证明；文章论证它同样改变带宽约束。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: A native zkEVM scales bandwidth, not just execution
items.note_en: 00:29 (mikeneuder). A native zkEVM is usually pitched as execution scaling, with validators downloading and verifying a proof for the whole block; the post argues it changes the bandwidth constraint as well.

keywords_en: frame transactions with keyed nonces and recent roots for privacy
summary_en: soispoke listed a CROPS wishlist for Hegotá: censorship resistance via FOCIL (EIP-7805, SFI) and privacy via frame transactions (EIP-8141, CFI), keyed nonces (EIP-8250) and recent roots (EIP-8272). misilva73 fixed a bug in EIP-8038 where `x → 0 → x` could yield a net refund, and it was merged. mikeneuder argued that a native zkEVM scales bandwidth, not just execution. Lighthouse v8.2.0 fixed several security vulnerabilities and users should upgrade soon. Vitalik ran an experiment to test whether AI text analysis can identify a document he wrote anonymously.
